existing: Automatic idle reflection, interest exploration, prototype and release preparation, expression/initiative stages and existing daily reflection allowance.
gap: Activity was checked before the whole batch and recorded only after conversation response; optional stages had no CPU/work/capacity gate.
change: Use the existing shared conversation and idle route. Track overlapping foreground conversations; recheck activity between optional stages and after capacity/budget reads. Gate optional stages on current CPU headroom, existing autonomous/model allowance and installation-scoped admitted/running delegated work.

installation.configuration: Only core/worker images changed; existing mounts, data, environment and other service configuration retained by the existing updater.
installation.priorRuntimeVariant: Exact existing seven-line restore-activation omission retained in development images; canonical repository guard retained. Separate hashes and normalization are in image-binding evidence.

limitations: Existing optional idle stages are reused; no new general optimizer/platform or proof that every app/add-on type is integrated.
CPU load/affinity/cgroup gate is an indication, not a RAM/GPU capacity guarantee.
The existing daily allowance is an admission budget, not a live subscription-credit meter.
A started blocking stage may finish to its checkpoint; this is not immediate cancellation.
Deferred reflection scopes are retained in process memory; this adds no durable restart checkpoint.
No real family experience or independent improvement-quality comparison was run for this scheduling correction.
Original L3 acceptances, closed AIDE/R1 trials, P2 conditions and 48/39 task counts unchanged.
userUse: No dashboard action is required. The existing automatic idle route may run during quiet periods within admitted capacity; normal chat remains foreground. Improvements still require the existing scoped development, independent evaluation and reviewed application route.
